title: Why a pir or shaykh?
ur: پیر یا شیخ کی ضرورت کیوں؟
summary: If the Qur'an, the hadith and the books of fiqh are in front of us, why give bai'at at anyone's hand? Hazrat's answers: the teacher, the one trusted guide, the power of company, and love for Allah's sake.

blocks.p: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at writes down the question people ask, and then answers it: the Qur'an, the hadith and the books of fiqh are all in front of us, so why give bai'at at anyone's hand?

blocks.q: Think carefully: two and two make four. Arithmetic is such certain knowledge that hardly any other is so certain. Yet from the first class to the tenth it is learned from teachers, and only then does one master it.

blocks.p: A person cannot see his own mistakes; the teacher keeps catching them. If a teacher is needed in such obvious things and in worldly work, Hazrat reads, then why would a spiritual teacher, a shaykh, not be needed for travelling the path of Allah?
Why stay with one shaykh? Hearing the different views of different people leaves a person bewildered, so one should make a trusted personality one's guide.

blocks.q: Think: if in an important court case a new lawyer were engaged every day, the case could not be pursued properly, nor could success be hoped for.

blocks.h: Istighfar with the one whose heart is lit

blocks.p: Every Muslim should do istighfar, so why is a murshid needed for it? Hazrat answers from the verse of Surah an-Nisa that he reads: asking forgiveness on one's own is not enough; the prayer of one whose heart is enlightened should also be sought. 'Becoming a murid begins with istighfar: the murshid prays for forgiveness for him, and there is hope that it will be accepted.'
Every person's thoughts and company spread around him, like ripples in water. If a big stone and a small pebble are thrown in together, the big stone's ripples swallow the pebble's.

blocks.q: In the same way, a person of ordinary thoughts and weak faith who sits in the company of a perfected one: his doubtful and harmful thoughts grow weaker and weaker.
There is an old saying: 'Whoever has no pir, his pir is Shaytan.' The murid has his master's hand over him, so Shaytan cannot touch him.

blocks.p: Is it necessary for everyone? Hazrat answers: for whoever hates bad things and keeps away from them, is drawn to good, and considers it necessary to keep the rules of the path at a high level. 'If you do not consider it necessary, you are deprived.'
Why does the murid love his murshid? For the sake of Allah. A person is with the one he loves, and the murids are spiritual children.

blocks.q: Who are these murids? Spiritual children. In sha Allah, the murids will be joined with their master; they will rise with him.

by: Draft prepared from the dars transcripts, awaiting teacher approval

ru.title: Pir ya shaykh kyun?
ru.summary: Jab Qur'an, hadith aur fiqh ki kitaabein hamare saamne hain, to kisi ke haath par bai'at kyun karein? Hazrat ke jawaab: ustaad, ek bharose ka rehnuma, sohbat ki taaqat, aur Allah ke liye mohabbat.

blocks.p: Haqeeqat-e-Bai'at woh sawaal likhti hai jo log poochte hain, aur phir uska jawaab deti hai: Qur'an, hadith aur fiqh ki kitaabein sab hamare saamne hain, phir kisi ke haath par bai'at karne ki kya zaroorat hai?

blocks.h: Hisaab ke liye bhi ustaad chahiye

blocks.q: Zara ghaur karo: do aur do chaar hote hain. Hisaab aisa yaqeeni ilm hai ke bamushkil koi doosra ilm aisa yaqeeni o qat'i ho sakta hai. Magar pehli jamaat se le kar daswein jamaat tak hisaab ki ta'leem asaatiza se haasil ki jaati hai, tab kahin us mein mahaarat haasil hoti hai.

blocks.p: Aadmi apni ghaltiyaan khud nahin dekh sakta; ustaad unko pakadte rehte hain. Agar aisi zaahir baaton aur duniya ke kaamon mein ustaad ki zaroorat hai, Hazrat padhte hain, to Allah ke raaste par chalne ke liye roohani ustaad, yaani shaykh, ki zaroorat kyun na hogi?
Ek hi shaykh ke saath kyun rahein? Alag alag logon ki alag alag raayein sun kar aadmi hairaan ho jaata hai, isliye kisi mu'tamad hasti ko apna peshwa banaana chahiye.

blocks.q: Zara ghaur karo ke kisi aham muqadme mein har roz ek wakeel badla jaaye to na pairwi barabar ho sakti hai, na kaamyaabi ki tawaqqo hai.

blocks.h: Jiska dil roshan ho uske saath istighfar

blocks.p: Har Musalmaan ko istighfar karna chahiye, to istighfar ke liye murshid ki kya zaroorat? Hazrat Surah an-Nisa ki jo aayat padhte hain usse jawaab dete hain: sirf apne aap maafi maangna kaafi nahin; kisi roshan-dil ki dua bhi chahiye. 'Murid hona istighfar se shuru hota hai: murshid uske liye maafi ki dua karte hain, aur umeed hai ke qabool hogi.'

Har aadmi ke khayalaat aur sohbat uske aas-paas phailte hain, jaise paani mein lehrein. Agar ek bada patthar aur ek chhota kankar saath mein phenka jaaye to bade patthar ki lehrein kankar ki lehron ko nigal jaati hain.

blocks.q: Isi tarah, maamooli khayalaat aur kamzor imaan wala aadmi jab kisi kaamil ki sohbat mein baithta hai to uske shak wale aur nuqsaandeh khayalaat kamzor se kamzor hote jaate hain.
Ek purani kahaawat hai: 'Jiska koi pir nahin, uska pir Shaitaan hai.' Murid ke upar uske aaqa ka haath hota hai, isliye Shaitaan usko chhoo nahin sakta.

blocks.p: Kya yeh har ek ke liye zaroori hai? Hazrat jawaab dete hain: us ke liye jo buri cheezon se nafrat kare aur unse door rahe, achhaai ki taraf khinche, aur is raaste ke qaaidon ko ooncha darje par nibhaana zaroori samjhe. 'Agar tum isko zaroori nahin samajhte to tum mahroom ho.'
Murid apne murshid se mohabbat kyun karta hai? Allah ke liye. Aadmi usi ke saath hai jis se woh mohabbat karta hai, aur murideen roohani aulaad hain.

blocks.q: Yeh murideen kaun hain? Roohani aulaad. In shaa Allah, murideen apne aaqa ke saath milaaye jaayenge; unke saath uthaaye jaayenge.
